newsitem.title: FINLAND: CERVUCTUM TO HAVE 39 PCT OF POLAR.
newsitem.headline: CERVUCTUM TO HAVE 39 PCT OF POLAR.

text.p: Finnish investment company
Cervuctum Oy, formed by big shareholders in construction group
Polar-yhtyma Oy, will be the largest owner in Polar through the
announced share issue, Polar chairman Heikki Hakala said.
"Cervuctum will have 39 percent of shares," he told a news
conference on Friday.
Cervuctum is owned by engineering group Metra Oy Ab, forestry group UPM-Kymmene Oy, construction material and cargo handling equipment maker Partek
Oy Ab and co-operative retailer SOK.
Polar said earlier it would issue new shares, convertible
bonds and bonds for a maximum of 2.4 million markka in total.
Polar gave the following list of the biggest shareholders
before and after the share issue, based on commitments by the
largest shareholders to subscribe the issue (percent of shares).
Aug 31 After the issue
Cervuctum 0.00 39.16
UPM-Kymmene 16.61 8.62
Partek 9.08 4.71
Merita 6.98 3.62
Kesko pensions fund 6.53 3.39
Polar will issue at least 50 million new shares, which would
raise the number of shares to at least 102 million, Hakala said.
